page.layout: One title page: centred printed lines at the top, a woodcut engraving in the middle, and the imprint at the foot. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: Engraving between the title and the imprint: a strapwork frame with two figures, a man on the left and a woman with a staff on the right. A hand emerges from clouds at the top centre and holds a pen or stylus over an open book on a plinth. Two banners curl from the hand. The left banner reads partly "LABORE" and "ET" ("ABO", "ORE", "ET" visible). The right banner reads partly "ANTIA" and "CONS" ("ANTIA", "NS" visible). The motto is probably LABORE ET CONSTANTIA, but the banner text is not fully legible, so it is not transcribed. The handwritten "254" in the top right corner is a library mark and is left out.
